label: political or organizational leader of
definition: Argument 1 is or was a political/organizational leader of group, legislature or political body 2.
scope_notes: Leader, head, chair and legislative leadership posts qualify. Mere candidacy, party membership or communicating to a body does not. Leadership in a legislature includes majority/minority leadership, not only heading the entire chamber.

facts.reason: Trimble is explicitly head and leader of the Ulster Unionist Party.
Daschle is explicitly a leader in/of the Senate. The malformed protege row is not needed for the judgment.
Dole is explicitly a Republican leader in both adjective and noun-compound paths. This supports leadership of the political group, not merely candidacy.
Lott is explicitly Republican leader and whip, including former-leader resignation paths.
Gephardt is explicitly a leader in/of the House and of its majority, covered by the legislative leadership scope.
